characters.name: 전세계
characters.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production individual character portrait for the existing Korean school romance visual novel RE:ACTION.
Primary request: restore the gentle original romance visual-novel character design and art direction shown in the six-panel reference sheet. Delicate fine brown-gray contours, softly blended pastel shading, subtle watercolor-like finish, natural muted clothing colors, luminous expressive anime eyes, understated cheek color, airy light on hair, approachable school-life mood. Match the original sheet's illustrator and face proportions closely. No heavy black outlines, hard angular cel shadows, jagged graphic hatching, theatrical horror expressions, black haze, panel background, frame, lettering, or watermark.
Composition: ONE girl only, portrait orientation, entire hair crown and both shoulders, torso down to hips, all visible hands and essential prop inside the canvas, small clean margin. Preserve her recognizable hair, face, clothing, accessories, personality, and natural body proportions. Ordinary fully clothed school-age female character, nonsexual, no exaggerated anatomy.
Output: transparent-background PNG with a clean natural silhouette, portrait approximately 1024x1536. No other characters.
Subject and input roles: Image 1 is the ORIGINAL DESIGN AND STYLE REFERENCE. Isolate and faithfully restore ONLY the FIRST girl on the far left: Jeon Segye, long softly wavy near-black plum hair, violet eyes, deep red rose above one ear, navy blazer with restrained gold edging over a white school shirt and large black ribbon. Her chin rests lightly on one hand as in her original pose; her smile is quietly confident, affectionate and a little possessive, never frightening. Preserve her original gentle face and hair volume; do not copy the newer dark gothic redraw.
